name: Nico's Bank - Emergency Line (account & card lock)
first_message: Hi, you've reached Nico's Bank's emergency line. I'm James, a virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

es.first_message: Hola, te comunicaste con la línea de emergencias de Nico's Bank. Soy Catalina, asistente virtual. ¿En qué te puedo ayudar?

fillers: Let me check that for you...

incident_type.description: One of: theft, robbery, loss. Empty if the call was routed to the chats.

incident_date.description: Date the incident happened, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

incident_time.description: Approximate time of the incident, 24h HH:MM.

customer_rut.description: Customer RUT as confirmed on the call.

account_locked.description: True if lock_account and block_cards both succeeded.

ticket_id.description: Ticket id returned by create_incident, if any.

incident_description.description: Short general description of what happened, in the caller's words: what was taken or compromised, where, and anything unusual.

csat_score.description: Caller's satisfaction score from 1 to 5 given at the end of the call. Empty if they skipped the survey.

csat_comment.description: Optional comment the caller gave in the CSAT survey.

protection_level.description: 'full_lock' if the phone was lost or stolen (account and all cards locked), 'card_only' if only a physical card was blocked, empty if the call was routed to the chats.

evaluation_criteria.name: Collected required info
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if, before locking anything, the agent collected ALL of: RUT, incident type, date, time and a general description of what happened; or correctly routed a non-emergency to the web chat. Failure if any of these was missing when lock_account or create_incident was called.

evaluation_criteria.name: No sensitive data requested
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if the agent never asked for passwords, PINs, OTP codes, full card numbers or CVV, and stopped the caller if they offered them.

evaluation_criteria.name: Empathetic tone
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if the agent acknowledged the caller's situation with empathy and explained things in plain language when the caller was confused.

evaluation_criteria.name: Consent and clear closure
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if the agent got explicit consent before calling lock_account, and at the end clearly told the caller that their account and all cards are locked, gave the ticket number, and explained they can regain access in 1 hour after passing an identity validation so the next person using the account is really them. Failure if it asked for date of birth.

evaluation_criteria.name: CSAT survey handled
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if, near the end of the call, the agent asked the caller to rate their satisfaction from 1 to 5 exactly once and recorded it with submit_csat, or politely skipped it because the caller declined or was distressed. Failure if it never asked, asked repeatedly, or pressured the caller.

evaluation_criteria.name: Right protection level
evaluation_criteria.goal: Success if: when the phone was lost or stolen, the agent locked the account and blocked ALL cards without asking whether the wallet or cards were also taken; when only a physical card was lost and the caller still has their phone, it blocked only that card and did not lock the account; when the caller had another issue (e.g. a transaction) and still has their phone, it locked nothing and routed them to the in-app or web chat without collecting the RUT. Failure otherwise.
